scripts.dev: npm run build:auth && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n CLIENT,API "next dev client --webpack --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3005" "tsx watch server/src/index.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build:auth && npm run build:server && dotenv -e .env -- next build client --webpack
scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -v NODE_ENV=production -- concurrently -k -n CLIENT,API "next start client --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3005" "node server/dist/index.js"
scripts.seed: npm run build:auth && dotenv -e .env -- tsx server/src/seed.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write client/app client/components client/lib server/src server/test packages/auth/src scripts docs *.md *.json
